verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents automations as multi-step workflows built from a trigger, goals, exit criteria, and workflow steps. They can be triggered by events or segment entry, and Wait Until blocks support chained delays. A community user also reports building strong workflows with it. missing for 10: explicit evidence of branching/conditional split steps, documented welcome/onboarding/winback examples or templates, deeper hands-on corroboration of complex multi-branch journeys.
